about: Beliefs (LIFE_SYSTEMS 4c, 4e): what people think a value is. truth: the stocks added (plus) and taken away (minus) to get the real value. who: each or adults (age 18 and over). noticed: flow ids (data/flows.json) the person hears about when they run; the belief moves by the amount applied. Any other change to the truth goes unnoticed until they check. drift: once a game hour, a belief older than afterHours moves by perDayPerPoint × (5 − anxious) ÷ 24 pounds, up to maxDrift pounds in total since the last check (anxious above 5 drifts down, below 5 up). check: the worry score for the action that observes this subject, and the log text when they check. All numbers are tuning.

check.logText: Checked the bank app: {value} in the joint account
